text:
Harper Lin: Heads-up: I think our postmortem follow-ups are slipping. proposal: weekly remediation-backlog grooming + a short IC-handshake procedure when rotations change.

Harper Lin: Grooming = 30m on Fridays, go through overdue items, re-assign stuck cards, and mark items for escalation. Add a "heat" column for items repeated >1x in last 90d.

Theo Ramirez: +1. can we also auto-add an "acknowledged" timestamp when owners accept a card? owner SLA = 48h to ack, otherwise escalate to team lead.

Samira Patel: ack SLA is good. also add a small "verification owner" field separate from remediation owner so testing doesn't get forgotten. and require a short verification note with dashboard links.

Evelyn Park: for recurrence detection, suggest two thresholds: repeat within 30d = monitor; 3 repeats in 90d = trigger postmortem review. we should include a simple recurrence tag on the card.

Theo Ramirez: for the IC-handshake: outgoing IC posts a 1-line "handoff summary": active remediations, open alerts, recent high-sev incidents, and any in-progress rollouts. incoming IC must acknowledge and pair for first 24h on any ongoing remediations.

Harper Lin: love the handshake. make it a checklist: TLDR + links (postmortem, runbook, remediation card) + pairing time. also capture access notes and escalation contacts.

remediation-bot: New template created: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-card-mini (edit: eng-oncall)

ops-bot: Poll: "Grooming cadence" (options: weekly Fri 30m / biweekly Wed 30m / monthly Fri 45m). please vote.

Samira Patel: i'll draft the grooming agenda and the verification checklist. aim for a draft by Wed.

Evelyn Park: i'll implement the recurrence tagger (tracker query + automation) and wire in auto-escalation at 3 repeats.

Theo Ramirez: i'll add ack-timestamp and owner-backup fields to the card. also will add automated reminders at 7d/30d/90d.

Harper Lin: volunteers: Samira (grooming agenda + verification), Evelyn (recurrence automation), Theo (card fields + reminders). i'll create the IC-handshake checklist and a tiny one-pager for rotation leads.

Samira Patel: on the verification checklist i'll include smoke, perf baseline, and a canary window plus a "metrics to verify" section for quick copy/paste.

Evelyn Park: for the recurrence automation i'll surface a weekly "recurrence radar" slack digest listing heat items and 2+ repeats.

Theo Ramirez: after we pilot this for 1 month we should run a 1-hour retro: did grooming reduce overdue items and repeats? if not, adjust thresholds.

Harper Lin: plan: ship remediation-card-mini + checklist + radar next week, pilot through the month. IC rotation docs + handshake will be mandatory for next rotation. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
